changelog:
Add Solid, Pulse, and Rainbow saved-scene effects across previews and scheduled cues
Preserve effect metadata through backup, occurrence, calendar, and scheduler telemetry responses
See CHANGELOG.md for the complete release history
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, solid, breathing Pulse, and hue-cycling Rainbow scene previews with optional bounded fade-in and fade-out transitions and administrator cancellation, cancellable default and per-user Test Connection diagnostics, cancellable System Diagnostics and saved-target validation, saved and scheduled scene cues with credential-free readiness and cancellable manual Run Now actions, daily, weekly, monthly-day, monthly-weekday, and yearly recurrence with bounded every-N-day/week/month/year intervals and short-month handling, inherited scene effects and transitions with per-cue duration overrides, recurring and one-time scheduled cues, bounded upcoming occurrence previews with iCalendar export, global scheduled-automation pause/resume with manual Run Now override, optional inclusive date windows and excluded holiday/blackout dates in each cue's time zone, per-cue time zones, DST-aware cue-local and UTC next-run observability, optional persistent cue history, safe scene restoration, credential-safe configuration backup and restore with a cross-server migration wizard, concurrent multi-room playback, per-user bridge mappings, playback performance, color scene, execution, channel, and restoration profiles, advanced color processing, seek recovery, startup recovery, bounded completed-session history with filtering/export/clear and opt-in persistence controls, multi-session telemetry, and auto-reconnection.
